method: Created branch cursor/aud-0081-claude-review-0db0 from origin/cursor/p2-loop-to-green-0db0 tip 2c364c6b1 (AUD-0081 BLOCKED commit). Read the BLOCKED receipt, probe1_filename_search.py, probe2_content_classify.py, control_prose_vs_hook_fixture.py, and _autoload_classifier.py without treating headline counts as trusted. Independently re-ran all three scripts via python3 -B from repo root; re-run headlines matched committed probe JSON (vendored_tree_root_count=4, hits_count=15, active_count=1, mention_only_count=2, inert_count=12, control ok=true with prose inert and PreToolUse active). Then git checkout -- restored all mutated probe JSON/raw outputs so only this review file is staged. Spot-checked the sole ACTIVE hit by reading tools/editor/ralph-orchestrator/vendor/examples/hooks/minimal/ralph.hooks.yml (YAML hooks: block with two command: entries and header -c/--config opt-in disclosure). Spot-checked inert AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md prose (setup-hooks.sh mention only), ralph-core/src/hooks (*.rs source), frontend/ralph-web/src/hooks (*.ts non-exec), hono jsx/hooks (index.js non-exec), mention-only .claude (skills/agents, no settings.json), and mention-only e2e features/hooks (*.feature + TRACEABILITY.md only). Ran five concrete falsification attempts (wrong/extra active, missed hit via independent os.walk, control both-states + adversarial mention/empty-hooks fixtures, scope overclaim vs single-checkout disclosure, AGENTS.md false-active from prose hooks mention). Did not run _pack_receipt.py, did not modify the receipt or any probe/classifier script, did not invent SUCCESS, and left receipt_state BLOCKED. This is the Claude half of the dual-reviewer requirement; disagreement with Codex is owner-escalated, not voted.
notes: Headline counts and classifications reproduce under independent re-run and filesystem spot-checks. ACTIVE remains a content-syntax finding for examples/hooks (real YAML hooks+command) with explicit opt-in disclosed in-file, not proof of default auto-load. Residual classifier quirk: empty JSON '"hooks": {}' text classifies active via regex; that does not falsify the catalog control (prose inert vs PreToolUse active) or any committed hit classification. Frontend .ts React hooks dirs are inert via the non-exec script-shaped path rather than the source-only path; still correctly not active. Receipt correctly stays BLOCKED pending dual independent review payment.
